edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 25 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 根据11月25日订阅邮件七则 Top Stories 按原始顺序原创改写，共21道单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: US equity indices retreated on Tuesday after rising sharply in the previous session.
items.cloze: US equity indices ______ on Tuesday after rising sharply in the previous session.
items.analysis_zh: retreat 在金融报道中是不及物动词，表示价格从较高水平退回，常与 from recent highs 连用。on Tuesday 限定具体交易日，因此使用过去式。fall 也能表达下跌，但 retreat 更强调此前涨幅被部分收回，并不暗示市场已经进入熊市。
items.why_zh: retreat 在金融报道中是不及物动词，表示价格从较高水平退回，常与 from recent highs 连用。

imitation.sentence_en: The index retreated from its record high after the earnings announcement.
imitation.translation_zh: 财报公布后，该指数从历史高位回落。

context.en: US equity indices retreated on Tuesday after rising sharply in the previous session.
context.zh: 美国股指在前一交易日大涨后于周二回落。

items.example: Nvidia shares fell nearly 6% after surging by 31% a day earlier.
items.cloze: Nvidia shares fell nearly 6% after ______ by 31% a day earlier.
items.analysis_zh: surge 指短时间内幅度显著的上升，后接 by 表示变动幅度，接 to 则表示达到的新水平。after 是介词，后接动名词 surging，隐含主语为 Nvidia shares；若用完整从句才可写 after they surged。rise 语气较中性，soar 同样突出大幅上涨。
items.why_zh: surge 指短时间内幅度显著的上升，后接 by 表示变动幅度，接 to 则表示达到的新水平。

imitation.sentence_en: Orders stabilised after surging by 40% during the launch week.
imitation.translation_zh: 上市首周订单量激增40%后趋于稳定。

context.en: Nvidia shares fell nearly 6% after surging by 31% a day earlier.
context.zh: 英伟达股价前一天飙升31%，随后下跌近6%。

items.example: Anthropic's stock also traded below its initial public offering price less than a week after listing.
items.cloze: Anthropic's stock also traded below its initial public ______ price less than a week after listing.
items.analysis_zh: initial public offering 是首次公开募股的固定术语，简称 IPO；offering price 指发行时确定的价格，区别于上市后形成的 market price。below 后接价格水平，less than a week after listing 说明时间间隔。不能用 offer 替换 offering，因为完整的金融术语固定使用后者。
items.why_zh: initial public offering 是首次公开募股的固定术语，简称 IPO；offering price 指发行时确定的价格，区别于上市后形成的 market price。

imitation.background_zh: 假设研究一家上市公司
imitation.sentence_en: The shares closed well above their initial public offering price.
imitation.translation_zh: 该股收盘价远高于首次公开发行价。

context.en: Anthropic's stock also traded below its initial public offering price less than a week after listing.
context.zh: 上市不足一周，Anthropic的股价也跌破首次公开发行价。

items.example: Nvidia's chief executive apologised to employees for violating the company's code of conduct.
items.cloze: Nvidia's chief executive apologised to employees for ______ the company's code of conduct.
items.analysis_zh: apologise to somebody for doing something 指向某人就某行为道歉，for 后接动名词。violate a code of conduct 强调违反正式规范，breach 常用于合同或规则，break 更口语化。道歉是当事人的行为，句子没有自行判断违规的具体性质。
items.why_zh: apologise to somebody for doing something 指向某人就某行为道歉，for 后接动名词。

imitation.background_zh: 假设供应商违反质量协议
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier apologised for violating the agreed inspection procedure.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商因违反约定的检验程序而道歉。

context.en: Nvidia's chief executive apologised to employees for violating the company's code of conduct.
context.zh: 英伟达首席执行官因违反公司行为准则向员工道歉。

items.example: Jensen Huang admitted making serious mistakes and said he was attending therapy every day.
items.cloze: Jensen Huang ______ making serious mistakes and said he was attending therapy every day.
items.analysis_zh: admit doing something 可直接接动名词，表示承认曾做过某事，通常涉及不利事实。acknowledge 也可接动名词，但语气较中性。这里使用过去式 admitted，后半句 said 保留对治疗情况的当事人归因，不能将其扩大为独立医学结论。
items.why_zh: admit doing something 可直接接动名词，表示承认曾做过某事，通常涉及不利事实。

imitation.sentence_en: The project lead admitted underestimating the validation workload.
imitation.translation_zh: 项目负责人承认低估了验证工作量。

context.en: Jensen Huang admitted making serious mistakes and said he was attending therapy every day.
context.zh: 黄仁勋承认犯下严重错误，并称自己每天接受心理治疗。

items.example: He denied that political pressure had secured his return and dismissed the idea of succession planning.
items.cloze: He denied that political pressure had secured his return and dismissed the idea of ______ planning.
items.analysis_zh: succession planning 是公司治理中的固定名词搭配，指预先识别并培养关键岗位继任者。succession 在此为不可数抽象概念，用作名词定语。dismiss the idea of 表示不认可某个理念，区别于 abandon a plan，后者暗示已有具体计划被放弃。
items.why_zh: succession planning 是公司治理中的固定名词搭配，指预先识别并培养关键岗位继任者。

imitation.sentence_en: Succession planning helps a team prepare for the departure of key managers.
imitation.translation_zh: 接班规划有助于团队为关键管理人员离职做好准备。

context.en: He denied that political pressure had secured his return and dismissed the idea of succession planning.
context.zh: 他否认政治压力促成其复职，并排斥接班规划的理念。

items.example: A US federal jury found Huawei guilty of ten criminal charges.
items.cloze: A US federal jury found Huawei ______ of ten criminal charges.
items.analysis_zh: find somebody guilty of an offence 属于司法判决常见结构，guilty 是宾语补足语，of 引出罪名。find 在此表示经审理作出认定，区别于发现物品的 find。convicted 通常用于 be convicted of，直接填入本句不如 guilty 自然。
items.why_zh: find somebody guilty of an offence 属于司法判决常见结构，guilty 是宾语补足语，of 引出罪名。

imitation.sentence_en: The jury found the defendant guilty of fraud.
imitation.translation_zh: 陪审团认定被告犯有欺诈罪。

context.en: A US federal jury found Huawei guilty of ten criminal charges.
context.zh: 美国联邦陪审团认定华为涉及的十项刑事指控成立。

items.example: The case included allegations of trade-secret theft and evasion of sanctions against Iran.
items.cloze: The case included allegations of trade-secret theft and ______ of sanctions against Iran.
items.analysis_zh: evasion of sanctions 是名词结构，表示逃避或规避制裁限制，与 tax evasion 同属常见法律财经搭配。circumvention 强调绕过规则的手段。allegations of 统领并列的 theft 和 evasion，保留指控的法律语境，不能据此推断每项行为的具体细节。
items.why_zh: evasion of sanctions 是名词结构，表示逃避或规避制裁限制，与 tax evasion 同属常见法律财经搭配。

imitation.sentence_en: The compliance team reviewed transactions for possible evasion of export restrictions.
imitation.translation_zh: 合规团队审查交易是否可能规避出口限制。

context.en: The case included allegations of trade-secret theft and evasion of sanctions against Iran.
context.zh: 该案涉及窃取商业秘密和规避针对伊朗的制裁等指控。

items.example: The company denied wrongdoing and was acquitted of racketeering and obstruction of justice.
items.cloze: The company denied wrongdoing and was ______ of racketeering and obstruction of justice.
items.analysis_zh: be acquitted of a charge 表示法院或陪审团裁定该项指控不成立，常与 be convicted of 对照。acquitted 是过去分词，和 was 构成被动语态。cleared of 更宽泛，可能包括调查后解除嫌疑；此处陪审团裁决使 acquitted 尤为精准。
items.why_zh: be acquitted of a charge 表示法院或陪审团裁定该项指控不成立，常与 be convicted of 对照。

imitation.background_zh: 假设阅读商业诉讼报道
imitation.sentence_en: The executive was acquitted of the criminal charge after a lengthy trial.
imitation.translation_zh: 经过漫长审理，该高管被判该项刑事指控无罪。

context.en: The company denied wrongdoing and was acquitted of racketeering and obstruction of justice.
context.zh: 该公司否认违法行为，并就敲诈勒索及妨碍司法公正的指控获判无罪。

items.example: China opened an investigation into Chen Jining, Shanghai's Communist Party secretary.
items.cloze: China opened an investigation ______ Chen Jining, Shanghai's Communist Party secretary.
items.analysis_zh: open an investigation into somebody or something 是正式报道的常见搭配，into 引出被调查的人或事项，强调深入审查。investigation of 也可构成名词短语，但 open an investigation into 在此更加固定自然。启动调查仅表示程序开始，尚无定罪结论。
items.why_zh: open an investigation into somebody or something 是正式报道的常见搭配，into 引出被调查的人或事项，强调深入审查。

imitation.sentence_en: The quality team opened an investigation into the recurring packaging defect.
imitation.translation_zh: 质量团队对反复出现的包装缺陷展开调查。

context.en: China opened an investigation into Chen Jining, Shanghai's Communist Party secretary.
context.zh: 中国对上海市委书记陈吉宁展开调查。

items.example: The anti-corruption body said he was suspected of serious breaches of party discipline and the law.
items.cloze: The anti-corruption body said he was ______ of serious breaches of party discipline and the law.
items.analysis_zh: be suspected of doing something 或 of an offence 表示被怀疑涉及某行为；过去分词 suspected 与 was 构成被动语态。accused of 也能构成语法完整句子，但语气更接近受到正式指控；said 明确保留消息归因，不能把嫌疑写成已经证实的事实。
items.why_zh: be suspected of doing something 或 of an offence 表示被怀疑涉及某行为；过去分词 suspected 与 was 构成被动语态。

imitation.sentence_en: A contractor was suspected of submitting duplicate invoices.
imitation.translation_zh: 一家承包商涉嫌重复提交发票。

context.en: The anti-corruption body said he was suspected of serious breaches of party discipline and the law.
context.zh: 反腐机构称他涉嫌严重违反党纪和法律。

items.example: The inquiry adds another name to the list of Politburo members targeted by Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign.
items.cloze: The inquiry adds another name to the list of Politburo members ______ by Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign.
items.analysis_zh: members targeted by the campaign 是过去分词短语作后置定语，等同于 members who were targeted by the campaign。target 强调行动将某人或某群体作为对象；investigate 更具体地指调查取证。该句只说明调查涉及的对象，不能推断最终处分。
items.why_zh: members targeted by the campaign 是过去分词短语作后置定语，等同于 members who were targeted by the campaign。

imitation.sentence_en: The suppliers targeted by the review accounted for most of the procurement budget.
imitation.translation_zh: 此次审查涉及的供应商占采购预算的大部分。

context.en: The inquiry adds another name to the list of Politburo members targeted by Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign.
context.zh: 这项调查使又一位政治局成员成为习近平反腐行动的对象。

items.example: According to Reuters, Gadi Eisenkot secured the backing of Yisrael Beiteinu in his efforts to form a government.
items.cloze: According to Reuters, Gadi Eisenkot ______ the backing of Yisrael Beiteinu in his efforts to form a government.
items.analysis_zh: secure the backing of somebody 表示成功取得某人的支持，secure 强调努力后获得所需资源，常见于 secure funding 或 secure approval。backing 在此为不可数名词。According to Reuters 明确来源，获得一个政党的支持并不等于已经组成政府。
items.why_zh: secure the backing of somebody 表示成功取得某人的支持，secure 强调努力后获得所需资源，常见于 secure funding 或 secure approval。

imitation.sentence_en: The project manager secured the backing of the finance department before requesting approval.
imitation.translation_zh: 项目经理在申请批准前获得了财务部门的支持。

context.en: According to Reuters, Gadi Eisenkot secured the backing of Yisrael Beiteinu in his efforts to form a government.
context.zh: 据路透社报道，加迪·艾森科特在组建政府的努力中获得了以色列我们的家园党的支持。

items.example: The move was unexpected because the party had previously refused to join a coalition that included Arab parties.
items.cloze: The move was unexpected because the party had previously refused to join a ______ that included Arab parties.
items.analysis_zh: join a coalition 指加入由多个政治团体组成的执政联盟，coalition 强调不同政党为共同执政而合作。had previously refused 是过去完成时，交代先于本次表态的立场；that included 引出联盟的组成条件。government 也可成立，但缺少多党合作的具体含义。
items.why_zh: join a coalition 指加入由多个政治团体组成的执政联盟，coalition 强调不同政党为共同执政而合作。

imitation.background_zh: 假设行业协会联合行动
imitation.sentence_en: Several industry groups formed a coalition to advocate for clearer import rules.
imitation.translation_zh: 几个行业组织结成联盟，推动更明确的进口规则。

context.en: The move was unexpected because the party had previously refused to join a coalition that included Arab parties.
context.zh: 这一举动出人意料，因为该党此前拒绝加入包含阿拉伯政党的联合政府。

items.example: Eisenkot nevertheless remained thirteen seats short of a parliamentary majority.
items.cloze: Eisenkot nevertheless remained thirteen seats ______ of a parliamentary majority.
items.analysis_zh: be or remain a number short of something 表示距离目标还差某个数量，数量放在 short 前面，of 引出目标。这里 thirteen seats 是差额，并非已经拥有的席位。nevertheless 承接获得支持的好消息，强调组阁所需多数仍未达到。
items.why_zh: be or remain a number short of something 表示距离目标还差某个数量，数量放在 short 前面，of 引出目标。

imitation.sentence_en: The warehouse remained 200 units short of its safety-stock target.
imitation.translation_zh: 仓库距离安全库存目标仍差200件。

context.en: Eisenkot nevertheless remained thirteen seats short of a parliamentary majority.
context.zh: 不过艾森科特仍差十三个议席才能达到议会多数。

items.example: Donald Trump is expected to unveil another round of tariffs affecting sixteen trading partners.
items.cloze: Donald Trump is expected to ______ another round of tariffs affecting sixteen trading partners.
items.analysis_zh: be expected to do 表示根据已有消息预计某事将发生，不表示措施已经生效。unveil 常用于首次公开政策、方案或产品，突出披露动作；announce 更通用，introduce 可强调推出措施。another round of 指又一轮政策行动。
items.why_zh: be expected to do 表示根据已有消息预计某事将发生，不表示措施已经生效。

imitation.sentence_en: The company is expected to unveil its new reagent platform next month.
imitation.translation_zh: 预计公司将在下个月公布新的试剂平台。

context.en: Donald Trump is expected to unveil another round of tariffs affecting sixteen trading partners.
context.zh: 预计唐纳德·特朗普将公布影响十六个贸易伙伴的新一轮关税。

items.example: The proposed duties follow an inquiry into alleged industrial overcapacity.
items.cloze: The proposed duties follow an inquiry into ______ industrial overcapacity.
items.analysis_zh: alleged 作前置形容词，表示某情况被提出或指称但尚未在句中认定为事实。alleged overcapacity 保留调查对象的争议性质，suspected 更侧重怀疑，reported 强调消息来自报道。inquiry into 后接调查主题，不宜将 proposed duties 描述为已经征收。
items.why_zh: alleged 作前置形容词，表示某情况被提出或指称但尚未在句中认定为事实。

imitation.sentence_en: The audit examined alleged breaches of the distribution agreement.
imitation.translation_zh: 审计调查了被指称的违反经销协议的行为。

context.en: The proposed duties follow an inquiry into alleged industrial overcapacity.
context.zh: 拟议关税源于一项针对被指称的工业产能过剩的调查。

items.example: They are intended to replace levies that the Supreme Court had struck down in February; the goods affected remain unclear.
items.cloze: They are intended to replace levies that the Supreme Court had ______ down in February; the goods affected remain unclear.
items.analysis_zh: strike down a law or measure 是法律报道中的短语动词，指法院宣布某项法律或措施无效。strike 的过去分词为 struck，与 had 构成过去完成时，突出裁决先于新政策。replace 指替代旧措施，remain unclear 明确商品范围尚未确定。
items.why_zh: strike down a law or measure 是法律报道中的短语动词，指法院宣布某项法律或措施无效。

imitation.sentence_en: The court struck down the disputed licensing requirement.
imitation.translation_zh: 法院裁定有争议的许可要求无效。

context.en: They are intended to replace levies that the Supreme Court had struck down in February; the goods affected remain unclear.
context.zh: 这些关税旨在取代最高法院于二月裁定无效的税费；涉及哪些商品仍不清楚。

items.example: The Court of Arbitration for Sport restored Senegal's status as champions of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.
items.cloze: The Court of Arbitration for Sport ______ Senegal's status as champions of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.
items.analysis_zh: restore somebody's status as something 指恢复某人此前拥有的身份或资格，过去式 restored 对应已经作出的裁决。reinstate 也可用于恢复职务、资格或头衔，常见于 be reinstated as champion。status as 后接身份，区别于重新获得一场比赛的胜利。
items.why_zh: restore somebody's status as something 指恢复某人此前拥有的身份或资格，过去式 restored 对应已经作出的裁决。

imitation.sentence_en: The audit committee restored the supplier's status as an approved vendor.
imitation.translation_zh: 审核委员会恢复了该供应商的合格供应商资格。

context.en: The Court of Arbitration for Sport restored Senegal's status as champions of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.
context.zh: 国际体育仲裁法庭恢复了塞内加尔2025年非洲国家杯冠军的身份。

items.example: Senegal had won the final against Morocco in January, but the African football confederation later transferred the title to Morocco.
items.cloze: Senegal had won the final against Morocco in January, but the African football confederation later ______ the title to Morocco.
items.analysis_zh: transfer something to somebody 表示将原属于一方的东西转交另一方，突出归属发生变化。awarded 更强调授予结果。had won 使用过去完成时说明原比赛结果先于后续决定；later 体现两个机构决定之间的时间关系。
items.why_zh: transfer something to somebody 表示将原属于一方的东西转交另一方，突出归属发生变化。

imitation.sentence_en: The committee transferred responsibility for the rollout to the regional team.
imitation.translation_zh: 委员会将推广实施的责任转交给区域团队。

context.en: Senegal had won the final against Morocco in January, but the African football confederation later transferred the title to Morocco.
context.zh: 塞内加尔一月战胜摩洛哥赢得决赛，但非洲足球联合会后来将冠军头衔转授摩洛哥。

items.example: The dispute followed the Senegalese players' decision to walk off the pitch after a controversial penalty was awarded.
items.cloze: The dispute followed the Senegalese players' decision to walk off the pitch after a controversial penalty was ______.
items.analysis_zh: award a penalty 是足球裁判术语，表示判给某队点球；was awarded 是被动结构，因为句子关注点球判罚本身而未交代裁判身份。give a penalty 同样自然，score a penalty 指罚进点球，含义不同。controversial 表明判罚受到争议，未认定判罚错误。
items.why_zh: award a penalty 是足球裁判术语，表示判给某队点球；was awarded 是被动结构，因为句子关注点球判罚本身而未交代裁判身份。

imitation.sentence_en: A penalty was awarded in the final minute of the match.
imitation.translation_zh: 比赛最后一分钟裁判判罚了一个点球。

context.en: The dispute followed the Senegalese players' decision to walk off the pitch after a controversial penalty was awarded.
context.zh: 争议源于塞内加尔球员在一次有争议的点球判罚后离开球场的决定。

passages.title: Wall Street loses ground after Monday's rally
passages.body: US equity indices {{2026-11-25-markets-retreated}} on Tuesday after rising sharply in the previous session. Nvidia shares fell nearly 6% after {{2026-11-25-markets-surging}} by 31% a day earlier. Anthropic's stock also traded below its initial public {{2026-11-25-markets-offering}} price less than a week after listing.

passages.title: Nvidia chief addresses employees
passages.body: Nvidia's chief executive apologised to employees for {{2026-11-25-huang-violating}} the company's code of conduct. Jensen Huang {{2026-11-25-huang-admitted}} making serious mistakes and said he was attending therapy every day. He denied that political pressure had secured his return and dismissed the idea of {{2026-11-25-huang-succession}} planning.

passages.title: New York jury reaches a verdict in Huawei case
passages.body: A US federal jury found Huawei {{2026-11-25-huawei-guilty}} of ten criminal charges. The case included allegations of trade-secret theft and {{2026-11-25-huawei-evasion}} of sanctions against Iran. The company denied wrongdoing and was {{2026-11-25-huawei-acquitted}} of racketeering and obstruction of justice.

passages.title: Chinese authorities investigate Shanghai party chief
passages.body: China opened an investigation {{2026-11-25-china-into}} Chen Jining, Shanghai's Communist Party secretary. The anti-corruption body said he was {{2026-11-25-china-suspected}} of serious breaches of party discipline and the law. The inquiry adds another name to the list of Politburo members {{2026-11-25-china-targeted}} by Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign.

passages.title: Israeli party leader seeks parliamentary majority
passages.body: According to Reuters, Gadi Eisenkot {{2026-11-25-israel-secured}} the backing of Yisrael Beiteinu in his efforts to form a government. The move was unexpected because the party had previously refused to join a {{2026-11-25-israel-coalition}} that included Arab parties. Eisenkot nevertheless remained thirteen seats {{2026-11-25-israel-short}} of a parliamentary majority.

passages.title: Washington considers further import duties
passages.body: Donald Trump is expected to {{2026-11-25-tariffs-unveil}} another round of tariffs affecting sixteen trading partners. The proposed duties follow an inquiry into {{2026-11-25-tariffs-alleged}} industrial overcapacity. They are intended to replace levies that the Supreme Court had {{2026-11-25-tariffs-struck}} down in February; the goods affected remain unclear.

passages.title: Senegal recovers continental football title
passages.body: The Court of Arbitration for Sport {{2026-11-25-football-restored}} Senegal's status as champions of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations. Senegal had won the final against Morocco in January, but the African football confederation later {{2026-11-25-football-transferred}} the title to Morocco. The dispute followed the Senegalese players' decision to walk off the pitch after a controversial penalty was {{2026-11-25-football-awarded}}.
